title: Bernoulli restriction weights factor over coordinates
statement:
Fix $n \in \bbn$ and a real parameter $p$, and recall that a restriction on $n$ variables is a map $\rho : \mathrm{Fin}\,n \to \mathrm{Option}\,\mathrm{Bool}$ assigning each variable either a fixed Boolean value or the free marker $\mathrm{none}$. Write $w_p(\rho) = p^{\,k}\bigl(\tfrac{1-p}{2}\bigr)^{\,n-k}$ for its Bernoulli weight, where $k$ is the number of free variables of $\rho$, and let $\omega_p$ be the per-variable weight given by $\omega_p(\mathrm{none}) = p$ and $\omega_p(v) = \tfrac{1-p}{2}$ for a fixed value $v$. Then for every family $h_i : \mathrm{Option}\,\mathrm{Bool} \to \bbr$ indexed by $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n$,
\[
  \sum_{\rho}\, w_p(\rho) \prod_{i} h_i(\rho(i))
  \;=\; \prod_{i} \sum_{v}\, \omega_p(v)\, h_i(v),
\]
where the outer sum ranges over all restrictions $\rho$ on $n$ variables and each inner sum ranges over $v \in \mathrm{Option}\,\mathrm{Bool}$.
hypotheses_covered: family of weight functions $h_i : \mathrm{Option}\,\mathrm{Bool} \to \bbr$ for each coordinate $i$
replaced:
For $p \in \bbr$ and any family $h : [n] \to \mathrm{Option}\ \mathrm{Bool} \to \bbr$,
\[
  \sum_{\rho} \mathrm{bernoulliRestrWeight}\,p\,\rho \cdot \prod_{i} h\,i\,(\rho\,i)
  \;=\; \prod_{i} \sum_{v} \mathrm{varWeight}\,p\,v \cdot h\,i\,v,
\]
so the Bernoulli weight is absorbed coordinatewise into the per-variable weight
$\mathrm{varWeight}$.
